mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN c.case_order = 1 THEN TRUE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM game_sessions gs INNER JOIN cases previous_case ON previous_case.id = gs.case_id WHERE gs.player_id = #{playerId} AND gs.status = 'SOLVED' AND previous_case.case_order = c.case_order - 1 ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM cases c WHERE c.id = #{caseId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO game_sessions ( id, player_id, case_id, status, score, hint_count, wrong_answer_count ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{playerId}, #{caseId}, 'PLAYING', 100, 0, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT id AS sessionId, case_id AS caseId, status, score, hint_count AS hintCount, wrong_answer_count AS wrongAnswerCount FROM game_sessions WHERE id = #{sessionId}

SELECT gs.id AS sessionId, gs.case_id AS caseId, c.title AS caseTitle, gs.status, gs.score, gs.hint_count AS hintCount, gs.wrong_answer_count AS wrongAnswerCount, gs.grade, gs.created_at AS createdAt, gs.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM game_sessions gs INNER JOIN cases c ON c.id = gs.case_id WHERE gs.id = #{sessionId}
